procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). Admission by reading: D, a claim on The Final Time (what it claims, its terms, its versions and identifiers, its authorship and byline, its reception as the archive records it); R, a relation the archive states between the work and an archive object (Tiger Leap, The Secret Book of Walt, Transition in Entropic Systems, the mantle objects, the datasets, the glyphic checksum, the seats, a heteronym); O, an archive category applied to the work by the archive (the release geometry of #1660, the organ / holder / route of #1725). A header line, a registry or navigation list, a byline or a bare mention is not a claim; front-matter fields are read where they carry the deposit record (supersession, creator). A machine composition the archive quotes is reception; the archive's reading of it is an archive claim. Volume is never a ground of removal; instances are grouped by lineage.
